description:
## Goal

Add audio capabilities to swarm-manager so the user can interact with it via voice — both for reviewing backlog items and for responding to decisions during walks.

## Scope

### Voice Input
- Adopt audio-tools voice input components in the swarm-manager UI
- Support persistent mode for hands-free interaction during walks
- Route transcribed text to appropriate UI actions (backlog commands, decision responses, etc.)

### TTS Output
- Adopt audio-tools TTS components for reading backlog item summaries, decision options, and status updates
- Integrate with the existing notification system
- Support summarization for long descriptions

### Configuration
- Add audio settings section to swarm-manager settings
- Pass provider preferences through to audio-tools
- Support the same three-tier provider chain (BYOK/LPBS/Local)

## Key Considerations

- Swarm-manager's primary audio use case is reviewing and responding to backlog items and decisions while mobile
- The voice command vocabulary should be tailored to backlog operations (approve, reject, next item, read description, etc.)
- Audio-tools handles all the heavy lifting — swarm-manager just adopts the components and wires them to its domain actions
name: swarm-manager-adopt-audio-tools
title: Integrate Audio-Tools into Swarm-Manager UI
